title: Offload In The Tackle Hands Free (Chas McIvor)
style: country swing bluegrass banjo brass bongo fast beat 134bpm comedy dad voice spoken interjections southern drawl mandolin steel guitar
lyrics:
[Intro - Chas spoken]
I say son, the offload keeps the ball alive
In the tackle, hands free, pop it to support
Before you go to ground, find the runner

[Verse 1]
In the contact, fight to stay on your feet
One arm wraps the tackler, the other stays sweet
Free hand controls the ball, eyes scan for support
Pop the offload short, son, the magic transport

[Pre-Chorus]
The support runner must be in range
Within two metres, hands ready, no strange
Soft pop pass with one hand off the hip
Receiver catches in stride, never trip

[Chorus]
Offload in the tackle hands free, son
Pop it to the support, the work begun
Keep the ball alive in the contact
Straight away the play stays intact

[Verse 2]
Fiji do it best, son, watch them play
Offload in the tackle, every single way
New Zealand also live for the offload
Keep the ball moving, never the slow road

[Bridge - Chas spoken]
I say boy, the offload turns one phase into ten
The defence cant set, the gain line is your gen
Practice off load drills every session
One handed pops, son, no concession

[Chorus]
Offload in the tackle hands free, son
Pop it to the support, the work begun
Keep the ball alive in the contact
Straight away the play stays intact

[Outro]
Hands free, ball alive
Pop the support, son, dive
Fijian magic, Kiwi flow
Thats my boy, let it go
